themes: Mix is moving away from Hero's core
Commuter motorcycles fell from 42.3% of industry two-wheeler volume (FY21) to 31.8% (Q1FY27); scooters rose to 31.5%, EVs to 7.0%, premium motorcycles to 13.5%, exports to 21.3%.
GST on two-wheelers up to 350cc cut from 28% to 18% on 22-Sep-2025; festive 2025 retail ~1 mn Hero units on VAHAN; industry Q1FY27 retail +14% (ICE +11%, EV +67%), July-26 +28%.
E-2W share of retail 6.6% in FY26, 11.2% in Jul-26 (204k units, +88%). TVS 27%, Bajaj 22%, Ather 15%, Hero 11%, Ola 7% in Jul-26.
West Asia conflict lifted metals, rubber, gas and freight from March; monsoon ended ~13% below normal (87% of LPA, weakest since 2015) on El Nino, a risk for rural demand in H2FY27.

critiques: The core is shrinking as a share of the market: commuter motorcycles fell from 42% to 32% of industry volume in five years and Hero's overall share from 31% to 23%
Share gains in scooters and EVs are from a low base; TVS overtook Hero in total sales in Aug-2026
Q1 margin hit (gross margin -475 bp YoY) shows limited pricing power in an inflationary year; the 14-16% band is medium-term only
Weak 2026 monsoon (87% of LPA) hurts the rural, first-time buyer that Hero depends on
Rs2,700 cr of cash committed to Ather in 2026 at Rs1,260-1,480 a share (~14-16x Ather's FY26 sales); capital allocation leans to a minority stake rather than to own EV scale
Governance: Executive Chairman paid Rs122 cr (789x median); ~20% of votes against his pay in Aug-2026; ED/DRI cases stayed, not closed
